about: Fight VENUES as rows (Backend 2026-10-12; Dom: everything as data). One row per venue, keyed by id. `perks`: the venue resolves the Section 10.2 (damage) patron templates (Strategy 2026-10-07: Origins PvE only; the arena and PvP get none, arena perks come only from Combat's no-damage sidegrade hook). A venue the rows do not name resolves nothing. A new venue is ONE row here; patrons.ts reads the flag, never a venue name.
